description: Authored pass/fault examples for method review, not actual gameplay or judge calibration.

cases.observation: User-controlled motion changes visible depth relationships; islands have height and an active start state.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Only a flat board, prerecorded fly-through or Start screen is shown.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Inputs change world position along both axes and the player can stop on a platform.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Walking animation plays while world position stays fixed, or one ground-plane axis cannot be traversed.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Camera yaw changes the view while keeping the player and nearby route usable during movement.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Camera controls do nothing, or turning leaves the character/route permanently hidden.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Character rises, crosses a gap, lands stably and falls off an unsupported edge.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Character floats across gaps without falling, falls through landings, or only a jump animation changes.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: The pillar and platform surfaces constrain the character; no traversal through visibly solid geometry occurs.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Character walks through the pillar or enters a platform from its solid side without a valid landing.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Before activation respawn is at start; afterward at checkpoint with the same collected count.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Checkpoint glows but respawn remains at start, or a fall erases collected crystals contrary to the prompt.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Each pickup increments once, disappears/becomes inert, and the count never exceeds three.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Revisiting one crystal increments repeatedly, or the count rises without world pickups.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Incomplete entry does not win; complete entry gives a distinct victory state.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Goal wins with fewer than three, or never wins after a demonstrated complete collection.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Fresh state and controls return; subsequent fall returns to the original start.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Restart retains crystals, the activated checkpoint or the previous victory.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Only an attractive still image and creator claim are supplied; no corresponding input/action sequence was captured.

expected.reason: Static appearance cannot establish the required interaction.

cases.observation: The browser-control transport failed before the game could receive any ordinary input, and no artifact defect was established.

expected.reason: Evaluator infrastructure failure invalidates the measurement; it is not a game failure.
